title: When I First Came to This Wondrous Land
transcription:
When I First Came
to This Wondrous Land

When I first came to this wondrous
land, I was not a wealthy man,
So I got myself a farm, and called it:
"Muscle in my arm."

And I called my farm "Muscle in my
arm," and the land
was sweet and good, and I did what I
should.

Other verses (in order)
A shack...break-a my back.
Duck...out of luck.
Horse...lame, of course.
Cow...no milk now.
Wife...love of my life.
Son...my work's done.

After each new verse, sing the preceding verses
with actions back down to the first, in order.
